owner..write: auth != null && auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider == 'password' && (!data.exists() && newData.val() == auth.uid || data.val() == auth.uid && newData.val() == auth.uid)

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['group','seat','online','epoch','joinedAt']) && newData.child('group').isNumber() && newData.child('group').val() >= 1 && newData.child('group').val() <= 6 && newData.child('group').val() % 1 == 0 && newData.child('seat').isNumber() && newData.child('seat').val() >= 1 && newData.child('seat').val() <= 6 && newData.child('seat').val() % 1 == 0 && newData.child('online').isBoolean() && newData.child('epoch').val() == root.child('foodTag').child($class).child('meta/epoch').val() && newData.child('joinedAt').isNumber()

newData.hasChildren(['x','y','action','epoch','at']) && newData.child('x').isNumber() && newData.child('x').val() >= -1 && newData.child('x').val() <= 1 && newData.child('y').isNumber() && newData.child('y').val() >= -1 && newData.child('y').val() <= 1 && newData.child('action').isNumber() && newData.child('action').val() >= 0 && newData.child('epoch').val() == root.child('foodTag').child($class).child('meta/epoch').val() && newData.child('at').isNumber() && newData.child('at').val() >= now - 5000 && newData.child('at').val() <= now + 5000

$group..validate: newData.hasChildren(['group','chain','reason','epoch','submitted','lastBy']) && newData.child('group').val() == root.child('foodTag').child($class).child('members').child(auth.uid).child('group').val() && newData.child('lastBy').val() == auth.uid && newData.child('submitted').isBoolean() && newData.child('chain').isString() && newData.child('chain').val().length <= 60 && newData.child('reason').isString() && newData.child('reason').val().length <= 300 && newData.child('epoch').val() == root.child('foodTag').child($class).child('meta/epoch').val()
